fact: Law n°027/2023 of 12 July 2023 on cybersecurity and the fight against cybercrime is in force, article 73 punishing fraudulent use of another's digital identity with 5 years' imprisonment and a fine of 10 million FCFA.
title: Gabon : 5 ans d'emprisonnement en cas d'utilisation de l'identité numérique d'autrui
